body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Nokia introduced its Bluetooth headset 'BH-904' during CES 2009, which is capable of separating a user's voice from ambient noise, ensuring good speech quality in noisy environments such as in the car, on public transportation or in busy public places such as restaurants.

It has the ability to maintain two active connections between the headset and another device at the same time. So a user can simultaneously connect for example to a PC (for VOIP) and to a compatible mobile device.
The Nokia Bluetooth also offers up to five hours of talk time after only 15 minutes of charging.
